body:
SOLAR ECLIPSE AMANITA TRIP
Note* The whole trip I was purifying the room and my body with White Sage, on reflection, I think this helped..respect your Energy...
4.2 Grams - Latvian Amanita Muscaria - Made into Tea ( Boiled purified drinking water for about an hour with the 4.2 grams, ended up ingesting almost all of it.. gave some to Mother )
T+20 - 1 gram - oral
T+ 1 Hour 40 minutes - Chewed up another 1g - Oral
T+ - Peeled back some skin off of a few good sized caps, mixed with weed, and smoked it.. definitely noticed the effects.. much more than just the weed by itself.. my mom also noticed this warm soothing relaxing effect... almost akin to rolling on E.
T+ 2 Mins - Chewing on some caps... about .2 - .4 g, I read somewhere online that a guy who uses Amanitas a lot does them very slowly, and this seems like a good idea.. I want to feel my way into them not jump in head first. Feeling my Chakras warming up in my belly especially the Sacral, Solar, and Heart. (This turned out to be a good idea)
T+ 20 Mins - Smoked some more... just finished boiling the Tea. made a cup... put some cloves in it for flavoring... put more water in the tea and left some more to simmer... VERY nice body high from smoking and chewing on a bit... chewing on less than 0.4 g so far I would say. Smoked the skin off of about 2 good sized caps... Mother also enjoys it. she blazed some with me and ate about 0.4g as well...
T+ 25 - Sipping the tea, reminds me of chewing on binder paper.
T+ 30 Mins - more sips on the Tea... I would say I put about 1-2 g worth of Amanitas boiled into this cup... it's really not bad at all, again decidedly it tastes like binder paper with a clovey aftertaste. Chakras are VERY responsive to Muscimol. Light Body is warming up, this would explain why people have strange experiences where they lose all body heat or start sweating profusely. Their energy is not balanced. Something very warm and amazing happening to the Solar Plexus Chakra as I chew up a little more... incredibly chill... warm... euphoric feeling. Weighted out another gram in case I want to chew more (so I will know exactly how much I've taken...as the dosage on these babies is very important.)
I take it slow with the amanitas and enjoy the warm nirvana.
T+ 50 Minutes : Definitely feel a change. It feels like a warm bath of energy... something definitely going on in my Solar Plexus.
T+ 1 Hour 5 Minutes : Very warm and wonderful feeling.. my solar/plexus Heart Chakra is going crazy...floating in warm Nectar... Stomach very tingly. So far no nausea just a VERY pleasant feeling.
T+ 1 Hour 25 Minutes : Very tingly and warm still... still great euphoric feeling... not many visuals. Fattt head change like eating 1000 brownies... my Chakras are all very active. I keep trying to sip this mushroom tea and it gets nastier and nastier as I get to the cold bottom of it. I think I'll just chew them from now on... I've waited a good hour or more so I think now is the time to up the dosage. Definitely having a very nice time... will do more often.
T+ 1 Hour 40 mins - going to go meditate. All Chakras are very responsive to the Sacred Soma, stomach a little bit gurgly... but so far no nausea.
T+ 2 Hours 10 Mins - Had the best Meditation ever...Incredible, Nirvana-like, all Chakras activated, body warm feeling... tingly... I can feel the energy coursing up from my lower centers which doesn't happen as often as I'd like, but the Soma appears to be blending my Energy with the Earth's and giving me a very pleasant grounding effect. I am a channel of pure Amithaba. Mental noise reduced to ZERO- Bless the Sacred Soma!
So far ingested -almost all of the tea with about 4.2 grams in it... about 1.2 grams of caps... burning white sage also helps.. Feel soooo goood... blessing and thanking the Amanitas for this wonderful Sacred experience. Going to lie down...
After I lied down I ate about another 1g.. .and oh my God as I was lying in my bed it felt like rolling on E. My whole body warm... absolutely amazing... blissfull.. Loving... I can feel the Energy Channels in my legs coursing with Kundalini Shakti.
